permit.quote: If you choose to create an account, we may process additional data to offer your account and to keep track of progress and statistics.

prohibit.quote: That's why we don't use accounts, and why there's no regular chat-box.

conflicts.situation: A player creates a Poki Account to save game progress, and Poki processes the account details, progress, and game statistics.
conflicts.reason: The same key-points list says Poki does not use accounts and also describes processing account data. Neither statement is limited by time, product, or user group, and no precedence is stated.

permit.quote: For our general processing purposes as included above;

prohibit.quote: It is important to note that we only process this data to enable the features offered by Poki Accounts and not for any other purposes.

conflicts.situation: Poki uses an account holder's game statistics or progress data for internal business operations, website analysis and improvement, or a merger.
conflicts.reason: The account section limits account data to account features, yet its purpose list for the same account processing includes all general purposes, such as analysis, business operations, and mergers. No statement says which governs.

permit.quote: We may also disclose such information about website visitors if we believe this is necessary to protect the rights, property or safety of Poki, or any of our business partners, customers or others.

prohibit.quote: We do not share your data in any other way.

conflicts.situation: Poki discloses a website visitor's data to a third party because it believes disclosure is necessary to protect the property or safety of Poki or its partners.
conflicts.reason: Section s7 says Poki shares data only with service providers and in no other way. Section s9 lists discretionary disclosures to protect rights, and s7 states no exception for them.

permit.quote: Poki will only share a pseudonymized account ID if the developer has warranted that it will only use the pseudonymized account ID for functional purposes, such as save games, entitlements, and achievements.

prohibit.quote: We do not share your data in any other way.

conflicts.situation: A game developer requests a pseudonymized Poki account ID for save games, and Poki approves the request and shares the ID.
conflicts.reason: Section s7 limits sharing to service providers that help Poki. Developers are not described as Poki's service providers, and the policy does not say whether the developer sharing is an exception.
